summary: Tests exercise real Textual pilot key presses + isinstance checks on SlugScreen and Input.value: (1) e with pane closed asserts no SlugScreen, empty set_slugs, and unchanged get_task slug — rejects both 'no-op' and 'silent rename' violations; (2) e with pane open asserts isinstance(SlugScreen) and Input.value == current slug; (3) a DivergentClient test proves initialization reads live get_task (service-current) rather than the stale list snapshot (stale-summary), rejecting a cached-value violation. Fake client is a genuine in-memory store (set_slug/get_task mutate/read real state), not a behavior-bypassing stub.
